deadline.intake: BBA-NextGen 2027 intake, 1st round (early admission) online application 26 Nov - 25 Dec 2026

tuition.note: BBA International (Chulalongkorn Business School), estimated total for Years 1-4 for students admitted from academic year 2026

requirement.text: BBA-NextGen 2027: aged 17+ with M6 or equivalent; English proof (IELTS Academic 6.5, or TOEFL iBT, or CU-TEP 101); aptitude test (SAT 1300 or CU-AAT 1270); video resume and portfolio of achievements, then an interview. Non-Thai applicants with a passport do not register in TCAS.
